item.tib: srid rgyal dbal mo'i srung mdos bskang zlog bsad mdos kyi glud mdel mdos gzhung
item.coloph: ces pa ye shes mkha' 'gro mas/ zhal lung bstan pa ji bzhin du/ nges med rnal 'byor tshul 'dzin pos/ gzhan phan phyir du yi ger bkod/ dam med log lta can la gsang / dam ldan yongs la phan thog shog sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
